# Faidz Agustiawan — Portfolio

Faidz Agustiawan is a full-stack developer based in Malang, Indonesia. He builds
web and mobile products end to end — database design, server logic, and
deployment — with a frontend focus on motion, interaction, and performance.

## Stack
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Laravel, Node.js,
PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kotlin (Jetpack Compose).

## Navigation
- [Home](/) — introduction and selected work
- [Work](/work) — full project list, filterable by type and year
- [Contact](/contact) — enquiry form, email, and resume download

## Notes
- Project records are served from a PocketBase instance and rendered client-side.
- Individual case studies live at `/work/<slug>`; see `/sitemap.xml` for the
  current list.
- Contact: faidzagustiawan@gmail.com
